sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: The upsides first: extreme micronutrient density. A direct stress test for whether meats underweight nutrient bombs. Heme iron case is very strong. Hard to ignore in meat scoring. Protein quality is excellent. Still a strong meat on the protein axis too.
